name: Startup Europe

sources.title: Startup Europe homepage — 'biggest EU Directory for Innovative Startups', free signup

requirements: European startups — 'an online directory that lists all European Startup Companies'
Free signup and listing: 'Sign up for Free and list your startup, improve your SEO, get notifications about EU competitions'
Account required: Submit a startup routes to users/join.php; dashboard at /dashboard
preparation: Startup name, country, category, description, website URL, logo
Complete the profile fully — a 'certification badge' for your website is earned by filling in the profile
workflow: Open startupeurope.net and click 'Submit a startup' or 'Sign Up'
Complete the startup profile (country, category, description, URL, logo)
Profile appears in the directory's country/category listings; earn the certified badge by completing the profile
watchFor: Site is plain HTTP-era styling and dated (© 2021 footer, contact via Greek address info@ied.eu) — verify it's still maintained before relying on it
Email notifications about 'EU events and surveys' are part of the deal — expect mailing-list additions
Badge is positioned as an earned certification — keep it only if the listing stays live
Low-visibility directory; treat as a minor backlink/citation
countsAsLive: The startup's public profile appears in startupeurope.net's country/category listings
unknowns: Whether outbound links are dofollow ('precious backlinks' claimed but rel not verified)
Whether there's any manual review or instant publish
Whether the site is actively maintained in 2026
Exact profile fields behind the signup
